The gamma process has three key properties: 1) X(t) = 0 with probability one, 2) X(t) has independent increments, and 3) X(t) - X(s) ~ Ga(v(t-s), u) for all t > s ≥ 0.
The probability density function of the gamma process is given by Ga(x|v, u) = (v^u * x^(v-1) * exp(-u*x)) / Γ(v), where v is the shape parameter and u is the scale parameter.
